notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You are able to play a land this turn.
description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Field of the Dead, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Field of the Dead trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
